resolution_criteria:
If the VoteHub time-adjusted average for Donald Trump's approval rating is above 43.0% at 10:00 AM November 14, then the market resolves to Yes.
The market resolves based on the VoteHub time-adjusted average displayed at 10:00 AM ET on November 14. The value must match exactly as displayed on VoteHub's platform, including subject name formatting. Values are compared using one decimal place precision. If VoteHub doesn't display data for the specified date, the most recent prior time-adjusted average is used. Only the time-adjusted average counts, not raw polling averages.
